changed.title: Signed tests on optimal fan-in-two AND/OR equality functions compile to one weighted matching polynomial with bounded edge activities
changed.statement:
let header := fun j : Nat => List.replicate j true ++ [false]
let fast := fun f : List Bool → List Bool =>
  ∃ M : Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) f,
    ∀ i, Finite (M.tm.Γ i)

let frame := fun j : Nat => j.bits.flatMap (fun b => [true,b]) ++ [false]
∃ write parity : List Bool → List Bool, fast write ∧ fast parity ∧

∀ (n : Nat), 2 ≤ n →
  ∀ (pos : List (Finset (Fin n))) (neg : List (Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n))),
  (∀ R ∈ pos, R.card ≤ 3) →
  (∀ i : Fin n, (pos.toFinset.filter (fun R => R.card = 3 ∧ i ∈ R)).card ≤ 2) →
  let Fn := (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool) → Bool
  let obs := fun (f : Fn) (R S : Finset (Fin n)) =>
    f (fun i => decide (i ∈ R)) (fun j => decide (j ∈ S))
  let fits := fun f : Fn => (∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*n ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun i j : Fin n => decide (i=j)) C ∧
    ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)) ∧
    (∀ R ∈ pos, obs f R ∅ = true) ∧ (∀ z ∈ neg, obs f z.1 z.2 = false)

  let size := fun f : Fn => (Finset.univ.filter (fun z : Fin n × Fin n =>
    z.1 < z.2 ∧ obs f {z.1,z.2} ∅ = true)).card
  let hist := fun s : Nat => Nat.card {f : Fn // fits f ∧ size f = s}

  let bank := fun R : Finset (Fin n) => (List.finRange n).map (fun i => decide (i ∈ R))
  let input := header n ++ header pos.length ++ pos.flatMap bank ++
    header neg.length ++ neg.flatMap (fun z => bank z.1 ++ bank z.2)

  ∃ (k shift mult : Nat) (a : Fin k → Nat) (w : Fin k → Fin k → Nat),
    k ≤ n ∧ shift ≤ n/2 ∧ (∀ i, 1 ≤ a i ∧ a i ≤ n) ∧
    (∀ i, w i i = 0) ∧ (∀ i j, w i j = w j i ∧ w i j ≤ 5*a i*a j) ∧
    let cells := (List.finRange k).flatMap (fun i => (List.finRange k).map (fun j => (i,j)))
    let edges := cells.toFinset.filter (fun z => z.1 < z.2)
    let verts := fun z : Fin k × Fin k => ({z.1,z.2} : Finset (Fin k))
    let good := edges.powerset.filter (fun Q => ∀ g ∈ Q, ∀ h ∈ Q, g ≠ h → Disjoint (verts g) (verts h))
    write input = header k ++ frame shift ++ frame mult ++
      (List.finRange k).flatMap (fun i => frame (a i)) ++ cells.flatMap (fun z => frame (w z.1 z.2)) ∧
    parity input = (List.range (n/2+1)).map (fun s => (hist s).testBit 0) ∧
    (∀ s : Nat, hist s = if s < shift then 0 else
      mult*(good.filter (fun Q => Q.card = s-shift)).sum (fun Q =>
        ((Finset.univ \ Q.biUnion verts).prod a) * Q.prod (fun z => w z.1 z.2)))

changed.title: A fan-in-two circuit evaluates every weighted fiber of a binary affine relation at the cost of blocked matrix multiplication
changed.statement:
∀ (a b c m t : Nat),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let X := Fin a → F
  let Y := Fin b → F
  let Z := Fin c → F
  let N := a+b+c
  let w := max a (max b c)
  let inputs := m*(N+1)+(2^a+2^b)*t
  let bitsOut := a+b+2*t+1
  ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit)
    (answer : Fin (2^c) → Fin bitsOut → Fin (inputs+C.size)),
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack inputs C ∧
    C.output = (answer 0 0).val ∧ C.size ≤ 2^60*(N+m+t+4)^30*2^(w % 2)*7^(w/2) ∧
    ∀ (H : Fin m → X × Y × Z) (rhs : Fin m → F)
      (f : Fin (2^a) → Fin (2^t)) (g : Fin (2^b) → Fin (2^t)),
      let pack := fun (s : Nat) (v : Fin s → F) => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin s => decide (v j ≠ 0))
      let bits := (List.finRange m).flatMap (fun i =>
        pack a (H i).1 ++ pack b (H i).2.1 ++ pack c (H i).2.2 ++ [decide (rhs i ≠ 0)]) ++
        (List.finRange (2^a)).flatMap (fun ix => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin t => (f ix).val.testBit j.val)) ++
        (List.finRange (2^b)).flatMap (fun iy => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin t => (g iy).val.testBit j.val))
      let decode := fun (s v : Nat) (j : Fin s) => (if v.testBit j.val then 1 else 0 : F)
      let readWire := fun n : Fin (inputs+C.size) => (C.wires bits).getD n.val false
      let total := fun iz : Fin (2^c) =>
        ∑ ix : Fin (2^a), ∑ iy : Fin (2^b),
          if ∀ i, dotProduct (H i).1 (decode a ix.val) + dotProduct (H i).2.1 (decode b iy.val) +
            dotProduct (H i).2.2 (decode c iz.val) = rhs i then (f ix).val*(g iy).val else 0
      ∀ iz j, readWire (answer iz j) = (total iz).testBit j.val
